the shelf as it is ordered before line cards are chosen.","kind":"base"},"fant-m-duplex":{"bays":{"nt-a":"nokia/fant-m@1","nt-b":"nokia/fant-m@1"},"description":"Two FANT-M (ANSI BA/BB) NT boards, redundant - the migration target.","kind":"orderable"}},"datasheet":{"sha256":"1a6b4edb84b46bc7742a0908b4472efcbf310e8aa30ed4dfc0a4e5b2a7e7705e","title":"Nokia NFXS-F BA (7360 ISAM FX-4 ANSI) Unit Data Sheet, 3FE 64991 BAAA TQZZA Edition 02"},"description":"The 5RU ANSI shelf of the Nokia 7360 ISAM FX (Lightspan Access Node FX) GPON/NGPON access node, part 3FE64991BB. The four line-termination (LT) cards, the two network-termination (NT) cards and the NT I/O card lie HORIZONTALLY, stacked from the bottom: the general facilities card (NGFC-G), NT A, NTIO, NT B, then LT1 to LT4. The BFAN-X fan unit stands at the right-hand end behind a fan cover that carries the shelf's name and the slot legends. Cards are authored upright, as the Unit Data Sheet guides draw them, and every card bay seats its card with `rotate: 270`, which turns the card's top end to the LEFT, toward the power terminals, as an installed FX-8 shows. The LT slots take only the LT blank until the line cards are modelled (roc-ops/Portrayal#538).","format":1,"gaps":[{"note":"Every ANSI-valid LT card the coverage grid lists is modelled and accepted in these slots, except FELT-B AC (3FE69486AC), for which no data sheet exists in any staged document. FELT-C is an ETSI/MII card and is not accepted by this ANSI shelf. The copper DSL/POTS cards (NDLS, NPOT, NIAT, NDPS, NVPS) are out of scope by decision (roc-ops/Portrayal#538).","reason":"needs-drawing","scope":["lt-1","lt-2","lt-3","lt-4"],"wanted":"a FELT-B AC unit data sheet","what":"line-cards"},{"note":"The top view in 3FE64991BAAATQZZA02 Figure 4 draws a column of openings along the left edge and fittings along the right; they are not transcribed yet. No staged document draws the left side, the bottom or the rear face.","reason":"needs-drawing","scope":["left","top","bottom","rear"],"wanted":"the top view transcribed; a photograph of the rear and left side","what":"side-top-bottom"},{"note":"The direction of the air across a horizontally mounted FX-4 is not stated; only the vertical mounting's front-to-rear flow is.","reason":"vendor-silent","scope":["fans"],"wanted":"a sentence or airflow figure for the horizontal installation","what":"horizontal-airflow"}],"groups":{"covers":{"index-origin":1,"role":"furniture","term":"Cover"},"fans":{"description":"the BFAN-X fan unit at the right-hand end","index-origin":1,"role":"service","term":"Fan"},"gfc-slot":{"description":"the general facilities card slot at the bottom of the shelf - power, alarms and timing","index-origin":1,"role":"service","term":"Slot"},"grounding":{"index-origin":1,"role":"furniture","term":"Point"},"lt-slots":{"description":"the four LT (line termination) slots, LT1 at the bottom of the LT block to LT4 at the top (UDS Figure 42)","index-origin":1,"role":"service","term":"Slot"},"nt-slots":{"description":"NT A (rel-pos 1) and NT B (rel-pos 2), the two network-termination slots, 30 mm pitch","index-origin":1,"role":"service","term":"Slot"},"ntio-slot":{"description":"the NT I/O slot between the two NTs, 25 mm pitch","index-origin":1,"role":"service","term":"Slot"}},"kind":"device","manufacturer":"Nokia","maturity":"modelled","model":"7360 ISAM FX-4 (NFXS-F BB)","name":"nfxs-f-bb","profile":"networking","provenance":{"airflow":{"confidence":"datasheet","note":"HIM R6.9: a vertically mounted FX-4 needs its mount kit's baffles \"to meet NEBS preferred airflow specifications (air flows in the front, and out the rear of the shelf)\". For the horizontal installation drawn here the fan unit sits at the right-hand end and the air crosses the cards; the direction is not stated in any staged document, so no airflow is declared."},"chassis":{"confidence":"datasheet","note":"3HH90279AAAATQZZA23 s8.5.2: width 447 mm, overall over flanges 481 mm, mounting centre distance 465 mm, depth 278.3 mm, height 221.9 mm; s8.5.3 weight 8.6 kg including the fan. The BA data sheet prints 447 / 480.5 / 465 / 278.6 / 221.9, and its own drawing labels the body 445.5. The body modelled is the 447 between the flange folds; the flanges (ears) are not drawn, per the method, and their extent is (481 - 447) / 2 = 17 mm a side."},"columns":{"confidence":"drawing","note":"Across: the GFC's face runs 7.6 to 414.4 on the drawing (outer strokes, 406.8 = 405 to the stroke), centre 211.0, so every 405 mm card starts at x 8.5 and ends at 413.5. The 8.5 mm strip at the left carries the card guides and latches. The fan column runs from 413.6 to the body edge; BFAN-X is 33.1 wide (UDS p386), which closes it at 446.7, and its top at y 4.2 is where the fan column's top line sits on the drawing (3.2 to 4.7)."},"defaults":{"confidence":"datasheet","note":"The default build is one FANT-H BB in NT A, the NT dummy in NT B, the dummy in NTIO and in all four LT slots, the NGFC-G and the BFAN-X. A shelf is never shipped with open slots - the dummies exist for airflow and EMC - and FANT-H BB is the current ANSI NT. The configurations below carry the other NT arrangements."},"ground":{"confidence":"estimated","note":"HIM R6.9 Figure 173 \"Grounding cable connection on 7360 ISAM FX-4\" (p297) points to the ground cable connector on the RIGHT side of the shelf, about mid-height and a little behind the front, and Procedure 59 routes the cable \"to the right side of the shelf and up to the middle\". The figure is a perspective view, so the position (x 22, centred at y 111) is estimated from it and the lug is drawn with common/ground-lug@1; the connector itself is a dual-hole lug seat for a 4 AWG lug with 1/4 in holes at 3/4 in spacing (HIM text before Figure 173)."},"model":{"confidence":"datasheet","note":"3HH90279AAAATQZZA23 s8.5 heads the chapter \"NFXS-F BB - FX-4 shelf\" (ANSI); the BA build is the R4.x-R5.x edition and its data sheet draws the same elevation, line for line, which is why its vector copy can stand in for the BB's raster one. That BA and BB share a front is read off the two figures, not stated."},"nt-occupants":{"confidence":"datasheet","note":"3HH90279AAAATQZZA23 and the ANSI UDS R6.9 list FANT-F, FANT-G, FANT-H (BB and the 125 W BC) and FANT-M (BA/BB) as NT boards for the ANSI FX-4. The ANSI FANT-F (BC/BD/BF, nokia/fant-f-bd@1) and FANT-G BA (nokia/fant-g-ba@1) are accepted. The ETSI builds (FANT-H AA/AC, nokia/fant-m-etsi@1) belong to the ETSI shelves and are not accepted here. The second NT slot takes the NT dummy 3FE65651AA when a single NT is fitted (UDS s12.3/12.4 - it \"must be mounted in the slot position of the second NT board\")."},"ntio-occupants":{"confidence":"datasheet","note":"FNIO-A, FNIO-B, FNIO-D and FNIO-E seat in the NTIO slot; the LT/NTIO dummy 3FE65651BA closes it when no NT I/O card is fitted."},"orientation":{"confidence":"estimated","note":"Cards are modelled upright in their own contracts and turned here with `rotate: 270`, so the card's top end (ejector lever, lamps, the NT port housings) lies at the LEFT, toward the NGFC-G power terminals. Taken from the FX-8, which shares this layout (GFC along the bottom with its terminal block at the left, fan column at the right): the owner's lab photographs of an installed NFXS-E (2026-09-24) show a FANT-H's lever and lamps directly beside the terminal cover. No photograph of an FX-4 is staged, and Figure 4 cannot say - it draws the card rows as generic grids with a latch at each end. An earlier revision seated the cards at `rotate: 90`, 180 degrees out. The NGFC-G (which only ever lies flat) is authored as it sits and is not rotated."},"panel-scale":{"confidence":"drawing","note":"Gate 1. The BA Figure 4 front view rendered at 1200 dpi: the body is 3120 px between its fold lines and 1559 px from top edge to bottom edge. 3120 / 447 = 6.98 px/mm across and 1559 / 221.9 = 7.03 down, 0.7 percent apart - and 0.3 percent apart against the drawing's own labelled 445.5, so the figure is orthographic and every position below is a measurement at about 0.15 mm/px, limited in practice by the drawing's 1 mm double edge strokes. The BB raster Figure 44 (150 ppi, 0.867 px/mm) was measured first and agrees to a pixel, which is 1.2 mm, and no better."},"power":{"confidence":"datasheet","note":"The shelf itself draws nothing: every consumer is a card with its own `power-draw-max-w` (from the Safety Manuals) and the fan unit's. The shelf is powered through the NGFC-G's -48 V DC terminals. No shelf-level power envelope is stated in any staged document; searched the UDS chapter 8, HIM R6.9 chapter 14.5 \"Power cabling\" and the Safety Manual 3HH12894 tables."},"right-vents":{"confidence":"estimated","note":"Figure 173 draws the right side perforated over roughly its rear half, full height inside a margin; the field is placed at x 128 to 270 and y 12 to 210 by eye from that perspective view. Hole size and pitch are not documented."},"rows":{"confidence":"drawing","note":"Card rows read off Figure 4 along the right-hand ejector column and the left latch column, then set to the vendor's stated pitches (UDS s8.4.1 \"NT cards: 30 mm, NTIO card: 25 mm, LT cards: 25 mm\"). Measured LT row edges 6.45 / 31.4 / 56.4 / 81.2 / 106.0 (pitch 24.9), so LT4 starts at 6.4 and LT1 ends at 106.4. A rail runs across the shelf between LT1 and NT B. The GFC takes the bottom 28.8 mm (the face nokia/ngfc-g@1 measured on this same figure, top line to the shelf's bottom edge), so it starts at 193.1, and the NT rows are stacked up from it at their pitches: NT A 163.1, NTIO 138.1, NT B 108.1, leaving the rail 106.4 to 108.1. The drawing puts the NT row edges at 110.2 / 139.7 / 164.8 / 194.5 - within 1.5 mm, the NT A bottom edge being where the figure and the GFC's own measured height disagree by 1.4 mm. The GFC's measured face was held and the difference taken up in the rail, because the GFC height is corroborated by a second drawing (its own front panel) and the rail is not."},"slot-legends":{"confidence":"drawing","note":"The slot legends (NTA, NTIO, NTB, 01 to 04) and the shelf name are printed on the fan cover, not on the frame - see nokia/fan-cover-fx4@1 - so the frame itself carries no silkscreen in this model. Figure 4 draws no printing anywhere else on the front frame."},"sources":{"confidence":"datasheet","note":"Written first, before any number. (1) NFXS-F BA unit data sheet 3FE64991BAAATQZZA02 (Edition 02, R5.3) p7 Figure 4 \"Top and front view of NFXS-F\" - a VECTOR elevation, the geometry source. (2) Lightspan Access Node FX Unit Data Sheet Guide 3HH90279AAAATQZZA23 (25.12) chapter 8.4-8.5: NFXS-F BB card positions (Figure 42), card pitches, dimensions and weight, and Figure 44, the same elevation art for BB as a 150 ppi JPEG. (3) 7360 ISAM FX ANSI Hardware Installation Manual 3HH12893AAAATCZZA29 (R6.9): Figure 173, the grounding connection. (4) the part contracts of every seated card, each with its own provenance. No photograph of this shelf is staged."}},"references":[{"sha256":"b06403047dff8db3becf71a183ce91a1f927fe3b99da8ec2ab546b9d1af97fb1","title":"Nokia Lightspan Access Node FX Unit Data Sheet Guide g.data-branches: 2 (A and B), each split into three feeds, 2 x 26 A (redundant)
g.data-fuses: 6 x 125 V / 10 A quick-acting SMD, three per branch, on the board, not user accessible
g.data-input-voltage: -48 V DC nominal (-40.5 to -60 V DC at the shelf connection point)
g.title: gfc--module

g.data-description: EBATRET branch connector, single-hole M5 lug (callout 1, first position)
EBATRET branch connector, single-hole M5 lug (callout 1, second position)
EBAT-A branch connector, single-hole M5 lug (callout 2)
EBAT-B branch connector, single-hole M5 lug (callout 3)
female 50-pin micro D-sub, 'External Alarms' - seventeen external alarm inputs and outputs, external ACO, and visual and audible critical, major and minor relay contacts (UDS Table 122)
six-pin right-angle wire-wrap header, recessed behind the panel, for the BITS inputs to NT-A and NT-B with frame ground between (UDS Table 123)

the DB-9 remote craft port (RS-232, UDS Table 124). The alarm I/O D-sub and the BITS header are management too, but no library part exists for either, so they are elements of this card and cannot join a group.
